project_music_style: Sparse Victorian ghost-story score: low strings, distant carol fragments, handbells, chain percussion; diegetic fiddle only if Fezziwig snippet used; silence as moral pressure; no modern pop.

scenes.score_intent: Cold ostinato under fog; brief warm lift on nephew’s entrance crushed by Scrooge’s refusal.
scenes.timing: Underscore enters after establishing city clocks/fog; thins for charity dialogue; ends on office close.
scenes.diegetic_sound: City clocks gone three; wheezing court footsteps; stamping feet; pen scratching; tiny fire spit; carol boy cut off outside keyhole.
scenes.silence_guidance: Hold dead air after surplus-population line.
scenes.exclusions: No comic cartoon stings; no lush full orchestra yet.
scenes.source_evidence: The city clocks had only just gone three, but it was quite dark already

scenes.score_intent: Unease to horror: knocker hit; bells; chain drag; lamenting wind voices at departure.
scenes.timing: Near-silence on knocker face; bells swell together; chain rises from cellar to door; dirge as Ghost departs.
scenes.diegetic_sound: Door bang thunder; echoes; disused bell then every bell; clanking chain on casks; booming cellar-door; jaw teeth smart sound; phantom wailings outdoors.
scenes.silence_guidance: After bells cease, leave only chain before apparition enters.
scenes.exclusions: No jump-scare braams; no spoken invented ghost choir text.
scenes.source_evidence: They were succeeded by a clanking noise, deep down below; as if some person were dragging a heavy chain over the casks in the wine-merchant's cellar.

scenes.score_intent: Soft distant tones; childhood music-box plainness; ache on Belle’s farewell; light extinguisher struggle.
scenes.timing: Church chimes to One; flash; pastoral cues on road; thin sorrow for breakup; collapse into sleep.
scenes.diegetic_sound: Neighbouring church chimes and deep ONE; frost window rub; boys’ distant Christmas shouts; mice/scuttle optional faint; no invented songs with lyrics beyond source context.
scenes.silence_guidance: Silence on Scrooge’s tears at lonely boy.
scenes.source_evidence: the heavy bell went on from six to seven, and from seven to eight, and regularly up to twelve; then stopped.

scenes.score_intent: Abundant warm present theme; domestic joy; chill when Tim’s future vacancy is spoken; dread sting for Ignorance and Want.
scenes.timing: Bell One; room transformation bloom; street scrape of snow; Cratchit feast peak; quote of surplus population strips music bare.
scenes.diegetic_sound: Roaring chimney blaze; dinner bustle; pudding copper; crutch on floor; chestnuts cracking; London bells to church; later chimes toward midnight.
scenes.silence_guidance: After “God bless us every one,” a clean hold on Scrooge’s face.
scenes.source_evidence: Then Bob proposed: "A Merry Christmas to us all, my dears. God bless us!"

scenes.score_intent: Near-anempathic drone; remove melody; heartbeat-low pulse only at grave.
scenes.timing: Enter with Phantom; almost no score over merchants; ugly small noises in junk shop; void around corpse bed; single tonal drop on stone.
scenes.diegetic_sound: Money chink; yawning laugh of businessmen; rusty shop door skreak; cat at door; rats beneath hearth; wind in churchyard.
scenes.silence_guidance: Spirit never speaks—protect long silent pointing beats.
scenes.exclusions: No choir spelling the dead man’s name early; no jump stingers on grave until name reveal.
scenes.source_evidence: The Phantom slowly, gravely, silently, approached.

scenes.score_intent: Release into pealing joy; honest laugh motif; gentle carol color without drowning dialogue; final benediction.
scenes.timing: Church peals on window open; light comic bounce for turkey errand; warm swell at Fred’s; soft resolve at salary raise; coda under Tiny Tim blessing.
scenes.diegetic_sound: Lustiest church peals; street bustle; knocker pat; boy’s run; office clock nine and late arrival; laughter.
scenes.silence_guidance: One clean breath before final “God bless Us, Every One!” card or line.
scenes.exclusions: No ironic dark reprise under ending.
scenes.source_evidence: Clash, clang, hammer; ding, dong, bell. Bell, dong, ding; hammer, clang, clash! Oh, glorious, glorious!
